notes.title: Null Path update v0.3.3
notes.content: [h1]What's inside[/h1][p]This is the final major update that brings Null Path to it's near completion! All of the levels, traps, jumps, puzzles and enemies are now created - the last remaining updates before release will only be bug fixes and small improvements based on player feedback. Plus a nice intro. And maybe a nice outro.[/p][p][/p][p][b]TON OF NEW LEVELS[/b]  [/p][p]3 new biomes [b]Factory[/b], [b]Ruins[/b] & a third [i][b]secret[/b][/i] biome! [/p][p]21 new levels + multi-levels + hidden levels[/p][p]Secret biome only unlockable through egg hunting[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW POWERUP[/b] [/p][p]Stasis - set your character in a state of suspended animation to avoid traps and progress through new levels[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW MECHANICS, TRAPS & ENEMIES[/b][/p][p]Lasers[/p][p]Clone Disrupter[/p][p]Fossils[/p][p]Teleporter beams[/p][p]Grim Reapers[/p][p]+ much more![/p][p][/p][p][b]OTHER UPDATES[/b][/p][p][b]THREE[/b] NEW EGGS! [/p][p]Big revamp of earlier levels[/p][p]Speedrun timer[/p][p]QoL improvements on some puzzles and jumps[/p][p]Bug fixes for reported bugs[/p][p]UI improvements[/p][p]Performance improvements[/p]

QoL improvements on some puzzles and jumps

notes.title: Null Path update v0.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]What's inside[/h1]

[b]STORY AND LORE[/b]
[list]
[*] added hidden lore around the game, waiting to be discovered
[/list]
[b]NEW BIOME[/b] - The Null
[list]
[*] 15 new levels
[*] new hidden mechanics with their own puzzles to solve
[*] new enemies (grimreapers, skeleton dogs, skeleton archers)
[/list]
[b]NEW POWERUP[/b]
[list]
[*] Aura ring of vision
[*] see hidden platforms/obstacles
[*] see into the null realm (careful of hidden enemies)
[*] hidden NPCs
[/list]
[b]NEW MECHANICS[/b] 
[list]
[*] checkpoint system - create a clone of yourself once per screen
[*] difficulty selection system introduced tied to checkpointing
[*] secret functionality from egg collecting
[*] hidden secret traversal mechanics
[/list]
[b]OTHER UPDATES [/b]
[list]
[*] ONE NEW EGG!
[*] updated wall slide behaviour to be able to continue to slide after a wall jump
[*] level pre-loading for faster screen transitions
[*] new shaders/animations for QoL
[*] more NPCs
[*] death counter (in pause menu)
[*] other minor improvements
[*] control button guide screen:
[*] playstation controller support
[*] xbox controller support
[*] keyboard support
[*] audio controls menu screen
[*] additional FX to make the levels feel more alive
[*] improved the flow of many levels throughout the game
[*] minor bugfixes and QoL improvements
[/list]
